column1: # ports.tsv -- THE source of truth for 6809-visible I/O addresses (spec section 7).
# One row per register range:   profile  engine  device  first  last
#   profile : TFR4  = v4's addresses (existing images run unmodified)
#             COCO  = coexist with a real CoCo 1/2/3 (spec 7.2)
#             E1    = the enhancement map; engine is "*" (any engine that enables the device)
#   Addresses are full 16-bit values inside the I/O page $FF00-$FFFF.  $FF7F is FORBIDDEN (Multi-Pak select).
# Generated from this file (scripts/gen-ports.sh): firmware C++ constants, NitrOS-9/Hatvan guest defs, docs.
# Do not reuse a tag after release: a changed layout gets a new tag (COCO2 ...).
# --- turbo9os (TurboOS; TFR4 only: TurboOS would have to be rebuilt for COCO) -------------------
# --- gep9 / gep9big (Hatvan OS).  COCO moves it off the PIA window ($FF00-$FF3F) ---------------
# --- multicomp09fuzix (Fuzix for the TFR; the port ABI is fixed, so TFR4 only) ------------------------
# --- enhancement map E1 (same in every profile; draft addresses marked in the spec) --------------
